description: Mark `id` as blocked by each of `blockerIds`, returning the updated blocker list. Adding is all-or-nothing. A blocker that is missing, in another project, the spec itself, already completed, or an ancestor or descendant is rejected with 400; a link that already exists or would create a cycle with 409, so remove wrong links before adding new ones. Children inherit their ancestors' blockers. Returns an array ({items} in structuredContent).

blockerIds.description: Ids of the specs that must be completed first.
